∀ (G : Type u_1) [inst : Group.{u_1} G] [Fintype.{u_1} G] (V : Type u_2) [inst_2 : AddCommGroup.{u_2} V]
  [inst_3 : Module.{0, u_2} Complex V] [FiniteDimensional.{0, u_2} Complex V]
  (ρ : Representation.{0, u_1, u_2} Complex G V),
  Nontrivial.{u_2} V →
    (∀ (W : Submodule.{0, u_2} Complex V),
        (∀ (g : G) (v : V),
            Membership.mem.{u_2, u_2} W v →
              Membership.mem.{u_2, u_2} W
                (DFunLike.coe.{u_2 + 1, u_2 + 1, u_2 + 1} (DFunLike.coe.{max (u_1 + 1) (u_2 + 1), u_1 + 1, u_2 + 1} ρ g)
                  v)) →
          Or (Eq.{u_2 + 1} W Bot.bot.{u_2}) (Eq.{u_2 + 1} W Top.top.{u_2})) →
      ∀ (c₁ c₂ : InnerProductSpace.Core.{0, u_2} Complex V),
        (∀ (g : G) (v w : V),
            Eq.{1}
              (Inner.inner.{0, u_2} Complex
                (DFunLike.coe.{u_2 + 1, u_2 + 1, u_2 + 1} (DFunLike.coe.{max (u_1 + 1) (u_2 + 1), u_1 + 1, u_2 + 1} ρ g)
                  v)
                (DFunLike.coe.{u_2 + 1, u_2 + 1, u_2 + 1} (DFunLike.coe.{max (u_1 + 1) (u_2 + 1), u_1 + 1, u_2 + 1} ρ g)
                  w))
              (Inner.inner.{0, u_2} Complex v w)) →
          (∀ (g : G) (v w : V),
              Eq.{1}
                (Inner.inner.{0, u_2} Complex
                  (DFunLike.coe.{u_2 + 1, u_2 + 1, u_2 + 1}
                    (DFunLike.coe.{max (u_1 + 1) (u_2 + 1), u_1 + 1, u_2 + 1} ρ g) v)
                  (DFunLike.coe.{u_2 + 1, u_2 + 1, u_2 + 1}
                    (DFunLike.coe.{max (u_1 + 1) (u_2 + 1), u_1 + 1, u_2 + 1} ρ g) w))
                (Inner.inner.{0, u_2} Complex v w)) →
            Exists.{1} fun lam =>
              And (LT.lt.{0} 0 lam)
                (∀ (v w : V),
                  Eq.{1} (Inner.inner.{0, u_2} Complex v w)
                    (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} (Complex.ofReal lam) (Inner.inner.{0, u_2} Complex v w)))
